dedupe_keys.name: before during and after flood uav generated images of the distal part of zackenberg river northeast greenland august 2017

description: Adam Mickiewicz University publishes UAV photographs of the distal Zackenberg River in northeast Greenland around an August 2017 glacier-lake outburst flood. Surveys cover a 2.1 km reach from the delta to the bridge on 5 August before flooding, 6 August during flooding and 8 August after flooding. The high-overlap images are intended for photogrammetric processing and use the aircraft’s onboard GNSS georeferencing. Zenodo supplies separate ZIP archives for the three survey dates under CC-BY-4.0, with open and free access. Camera-image encoding and ground-control accuracy were not checked inside the archives. A limitation is that raw image coordinates alone do not establish survey-grade terrain accuracy. The photographs could reconstruct inundation, erosion or channel change for simulations affecting the research station and bridge. They complement the separately deposited processed elevation and mapping products by preserving the source imagery needed for alternative processing.
